description: This Java source file defines the Adapters class for loading and managing XML-defined adapters in an Android application, including nested classes for binding data from cursors to views, transformations, and parser logic for XML adapter definitions.

classes.name: Adapters
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to load adapters from XML resources or cursors, and nested classes for binding and transforming cursor data.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorBinder
classes.description: Interface for binding cursor columns to views, supporting custom binding logic.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorTransformation
classes.description: Abstract class for transforming cursor data before binding to views.

classes.name: Adapters.XmlCursorAdapter
classes.description: Implementation of a cursor adapter loaded from XML, extending SimpleCursorAdapter with additional binding capabilities.

classes.name: Adapters.IdentityTransformation
classes.description: Default transformation returning cursor column data as a string without modification.

classes.name: Adapters.ExpressionTransformation
classes.description: Transforms cursor data into a formatted string based on an expression with placeholders for column values.

classes.name: Adapters.MapTransformation
classes.description: Transforms cursor data by mapping specific string values to other strings or resource IDs.

classes.name: Adapters.XmlCursorAdapterParser
classes.description: Parser class for reading XML definitions of cursor adapters and creating corresponding adapter instances.

methods.name: loadCursorAdapter
methods.description: Loads a CursorAdapter from XML resource or cursor, with optional URI and parameters.

methods.name: loadAdapter
methods.description: Loads a generic adapter from XML resource, optionally managing its lifecycle.

methods.name: createAdapterFromXml
methods.description: Creates an adapter instance based on XML parser content, ensuring correct root tag.

methods.name: createCursorAdapter
methods.description: Creates an XmlCursorAdapter instance from XML parser.
